name: compare_two_projects_and_remind
description: Two projects in one message plus a write that depends on comparing them. Forces list_tasks twice with different project_ids, then create_reminder. Also pins the date bug: a reminder for 'el viernes' must not land in the past.

turns.message: Comparame Onebox2026 y Marketing Q3: dime cuantas tareas pendientes tiene cada uno, cual de los dos va mas retrasado, y creame un recordatorio para revisar el que peor este, para el viernes de esta semana
turns.why: Two reads that cannot be merged, then one write whose target depends on both.

assert.comment: The planner has no current date in its prompt, so it invents one. On 2026-09-20 it produced due dates in June. '20226-' is the malformed date already seen in production.
